fusions.name: Run Aground
fusions.desc: Drives the target onto a spur of reef. The grounding deals 14 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and makes it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scraped Keel
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Grinds past every enemy within 2.5 tiles: it deals 8 damage and leaves each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hulk at Anchor
fusions.desc: Sinks a reef-grown hulk where you stand. It stays for 15 seconds, and every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Barnacle Skin
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield for each stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
